name: Ani Miloshova
intro: Cozy, nostalgic paintings in oil, acrylic and watercolour: cottages with flowers everywhere, misty forests, old streets, still lifes and a little bit of magic. Welcome to my gallery.

about.title: A few words about me
about.quote: Meant to create beautiful, gentle things…
paragraphs: I am Ani Miloshova, an artist from Bulgaria. Around the age of 17–18 my paintings started to look truly professional, and soon after that they found their way into galleries.
I graduated from the English Language High School and studied Tourism at Sofia University. My favourite materials are acrylic, oil paints and watercolour.
Besides painting, I also make handmade jewellery. I love old legends, like the Krampus, the Yule Cat and the karakonjuls of the Balkan winter nights, and I bring them to life in my art.
My newest paintings are about nostalgia and slow living: cozy cottages, misty forests, quiet old streets. They are a small escape from the rush of modern life, and every one of them is made by hand.
I share them on Instagram as @ani.miloshova.paintings. Every painting starts with a story, and I hope you find a little bit of it in each one.

commissions.title: Paintings made for you
commissions.intro: Would you like a painting just for you, or as a gift for someone you love? These are the things I love to paint the most.

items.title: Your home, painted
items.text: Your house, your grandparents' village home or a favourite old street, painted in the same cozy style as my cottages and old towns.

items.title: Animals & pets
items.text: A portrait of your cat, dog or horse, sitting in a meadow full of flowers or with a little bit of magic around it.

items.title: Flowers & still life
items.text: Peonies, roses, herbs or a still life with your favourite things: a warm, bright gift for any home.

commissions.note: Every commission is painted by hand in oil, acrylic or watercolour. Write to me with your idea, the size you would like and a photo, and I will tell you the price and how long it will take.

prints.title: Prints & cards
prints.intro: Can't take the original home? My favourite paintings are also printed on thick, matte art paper.

items.title: Art prints
items.text: High-quality prints of my paintings in A4 and A3, signed by hand. Ready for a frame.

items.title: Postcards
items.text: A set of postcards with cottages, flowers and misty forests, to send or to keep.

items.title: Greeting cards
items.text: Folded cards with an envelope, blank inside, for birthdays, holidays or just because.

prints.note: Write to me which painting and size you would like. Prints are sent by post within Bulgaria and abroad.

items.q: How do I buy a painting?
items.a: Write to me through the form below or by email, with the name of the painting. I will confirm it is still available, send you the price with shipping, and reserve it for you.
Yes. I ship within Bulgaria with a courier and abroad by post, carefully wrapped. The cost depends on the size and the country.
Some come in a frame and some without one; it is written in the details of each painting. I can also suggest a frame that suits it.

items.q: How long does a commission take?
items.a: Usually two to four weeks, depending on the size and the technique. I will tell you an exact date before I start.
By bank transfer, or in cash when we meet in person. For commissions I ask for half in advance and the rest when the painting is ready.

items.q: How do I take care of a painting?
items.a: Keep it away from direct sunlight and damp walls, and dust it gently with a soft, dry cloth. Watercolours are best kept behind glass.
